step2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), display the [ECU Data Monitor] screen according to the screen display, and check the computer data.

item.ptxt: Data monitor values vary greatly due to slight differences in measurement, differences in measurement environment or changes in the vehicle over time, so it is difficult to give clear standard values (judgment values). Therefore, a malfunction may exist even if values are within the reference range.

For subtle symptoms such as hesitation or rough idle, it is necessary to make an overall judgment from all data monitor items by collecting and comparing data from a vehicle of the same model under the same conditions.
